# Captured / source-verified LEGACY AOSP `external/ping` / `ping6` diagnostic
# lines and the ErrorType each must map to through PingLinux.androidParser. One
# line per case; `#` comments and blank lines are ignored by the loader. Legacy
# output is 2008-vintage iputils, so these phrasings are the iputils forms —
# verified against iputils `ping.c` / `ping6.c` (tag s20101006, the same lineage
# the §spec:android-legacy-ci-gate flag-acceptance job builds). See
# android_legacy_output_parity_test.dart.
#
# Name-resolution failure. Legacy iputils prints `ping: unknown host` (v4) and
# `ping6: unknown host <name>` (v6); both are matched by the shared
# `unknown host` alternative in androidParser's unknownHostStr.
unknownHost | ping: unknown host
unknownHost | ping6: unknown host www.example.invalid
#
# Routing failures. The legacy IPv4 `ping` surfaces an unreachable network from
# the connect() probe (`connect: Network is unreachable`) and an intermediate
# router's ICMP unreachable as `From <hop>: No route to host`. Both map to
# noRoute via androidParser's noRouteStrs.
noRoute | connect: Network is unreachable
noRoute | From 192.168.1.1: No route to host
#
# TTL/hop-limit expiry. Unlike toybox (which surfaces this as a kernel errno),
# the legacy iputils binary prints a dedicated `From <hop> icmp_seq=<n> Time to
# live exceeded` line for both families; androidParser's timeToLiveRgx captures
# the hop `ip` (IPv4 dotted quad OR IPv6 address) and the probe `seq`.
timeToLiveExceeded | From 10.0.0.1 icmp_seq=1 Time to live exceeded
timeToLiveExceeded | From 2001:db8::1 icmp_seq=2 Time to live exceeded
